title: The start-up error test insists on telling members to send their whole data file to the gym
what: The phone test of the start-up error screen checks, word for word, the line telling the member to send the saved data file to their gym. That file holds body weight, notes, profile and phone number. The test passes only while the risky advice is there.
expected: The test should check that the screen never advises sending the whole data file to the gym, and fail if it does.
fix_line: Change the advice on the error screen, then make the test check the new words and that the gym is not named as where to send the file

title: Bringing back a Google Drive backup from the welcome screen is never tested beyond two lines of words
what: No test signs in with Google on the welcome screen, finds a backup, restores it, cancels, finds none, or takes the gym's copy. Only the 'we found your backup' line, the replace warning line and the 18+ tick rule are checked. Nothing checks that only the MettleUp backup file in Drive is read.
expected: A phone test that finds a backup, asks before replacing the workouts on the phone, restores it and opens the app; plus the no-backup, cancel and gym-copy paths, and a check that Drive access stays limited to the app's own file.
how_often: every new phone with a backup
fix_line: Add a phone test of the welcome Google sign-in with a test Drive backup, covering restore, replace, none and cancel
